Resolves #18036

Refs #17540

A new guide, `learn/guides/uibuildingblocks/DockLayoutsStyling.md`, teaches how to give a dock your product's look without copying engine paint: the three styling layers and the direction values flow, selector weight before stylesheet order, how tokens reach body-mounted chrome and panes in other windows, the inline header and its action rail, the affordance floor, one real failure-and-fix story, and verification on the rendered element. It is registered in `learn/tree.json` and the SEO `PRIORITIES` input. Two Workstation SCSS comments the guide sends readers to are corrected in the same change.

Evidence: L3 (computed styles and screenshots read on rendered consumers — the standalone dock example in every shipped theme, the Workstation in both palettes, a dock component fixture — plus a headless portal render with a merged-guide control) → L2 required (documentation; the SCSS changes are comment-only). No residual beyond the cross-family whole-guide review this PR requests.

## Deltas from ticket

- **Workstation SCSS comments.** The comment above the tooltip bridge still gave the pre-`:where()` tooltip weight as its reason; the comment above the viewport bridge described a vessel as a viewport "without a workspace", when a `PopupWorkspace` owns the vessel's document and only the root `Workstation.view.Workspace` is absent. Both are rewritten to the reasons that hold; comment-only.
- **Navigation name.** The tree entry reads `Dock Layouts: Styling and Action Chrome`, shorter than the H1, to keep the tree's column alignment.
- **Out of scope, noted in defect-note:** `theme-cyberpunk` values the dashboard layer but not the tab header's sizing tokens, the tooltip or the menu, so a dock in that theme renders collapsed headers. The guide teaches the per-package coverage rule instead of naming the gap.

## Test Evidence

Every receipt was served from this branch's source and theme build; the main checkout supplied only `node_modules` and absent `dist` bundles, listed per run.

- **Every shipped theme, standalone example** (`examples/dashboard/dock`, `neo-config.json` routed to one theme per run): inline header neo-dark `rgb(41, 45, 40)` + inset hairline at 32px, neo-light `rgb(255, 255, 255)` + hairline at 32px, dark `rgb(60, 63, 65)` at 25px, light `rgb(242, 242, 242)` at 25px, cyberpunk transparent at 12px (Deltas). Values-layer tokens match each theme (accept `#5eead4` · `#0d9488` · `#64b5f6` · `#1c60a0` · `#00d2ff`); the splitter band resolves from each theme's own ink at 9 %; neo-theme tooltips paint `rgb(62, 99, 221)`.
- **Workstation, both palettes:** tooltip `rgb(26, 33, 44)` and `rgb(247, 249, 252)`, each equal to that palette's `--workstation-panel-2`; rail tab `min-width: 0px`; inline header carries the app's own gradient.
- **Action order:** `dock-maximize` fixture reads `close` before focus and `lock · reload · maximize · close` after focusing Alpha; a Workstation header with overflowing tabs reads `More tabs · close`.
- **Floating and overlay chrome** (Workstation, neo-dark): overflow menu mounted at `body` with background `#1a212c`, the palette's panel; reveal overlay ground `#0e131a` with a signal glow in its shadow; during a held drag `.neo-dock-preview` is `absolute`, inset `0`, z-index `25` with 4 drop chips, and the drag proxy wears `neo-theme-neo-dark` with ground `#141a23`.
- **Popup vessel** (`?popout=queues`): the pane host is a `PopupWorkspace` (`workstation-vessel-dock-host neo-dashboard neo-dock-workspace`); no `.workstation-workspace`; the vessel document loaded `src/apps/workstation/Viewport.css` and both theme `Viewport.css` sheets, and no `Workspace.css`.
- **Portal render** (headless Chromium, this branch, scrolled heading by heading): `#/learn/guides/uibuildingblocks/DockLayoutsStyling` shows its h1 and 1 SVG of 9 nodes, no syntax error. Control `DockLayoutsPanes` on the same path: 2 SVGs of 7 nodes each. Both pages throw the same pre-existing App Worker `TypeError` from `SectionsList.getItemRecordId`, and both clip each node label's last glyph in headless Chromium.
- **Independent Mermaid control:** the fence renders in a blank document with `node_modules/mermaid/dist/mermaid.min.js`; a deliberately broken fence fails to parse.
- **Guide lint** (Brain `ai/scripts/lint/lint-guides.mjs` at `76313d6`): full rules 0 hard / 0 warn; ticket-id scan 0 findings. **Tree:** 139 items, no duplicate ids, no orphan parents, every leaf backed by a file. `check-relative-links`: OK.
